Which is better: Text-to-Video or Image-to-Video?
Text-to-Video is for new concepts from scratch. Image-to-Video is best for absolute control over character design or branding.
Can I use generated videos for commercial purposes?
Absolutely! As long as you own the rights to the original image, the resulting video is cleared for commercial use.
